description: Triage an incoming work item (under docs/discovery/) - a bug report, request, or incident - so it is correctly understood, classified, and routed before anyone builds. Use when the user says "triage MN-42", "is this a real bug?", "can you reproduce this?", "what priority is this", "is this a duplicate", "look into this report/incident", or hands you an inbound item to assess. Reads the item and its evidence, reproduces or characterises the problem, classifies and prioritises it, checks for duplicates, and records a triage note. Do NOT use to CREATE an item (that is elaboration-upsert-user-story), to rewrite an item's content (that is governance-enrich-ticket), or to implement the fix (that is mature-resolve-ticket).
